route: scripted (procedural Blender geometry, rig and keyed clips; no provider generation)

skin.policy: rigid: one bone per vertex at weight 1.0

rootMotion: code-owned: the root joint is never animated and every clip plays in place

frame.note: encounter.ts rotation.y = -heading turns local -Z onto the heading

references.note: P4-T2 concept sheet picked for the Cog Sentry (docs/art-bible.md)

materialsUsed: approved P4-T3 brass-polished and brass-aged sets bound by slot name at runtime, each sampled at one texel (constant UV) and tinted by its manifest slot tint (linear multiplier); gunmetal (gunmetal and jewels from COLOR_0) and sentry-glow are factor-only
license: Original work generated in Blender from a checked-in script; concept reference from Paul's paid Higgsfield plan (Terms of Use 4.4)

checks: reimport gate (weights, influences, clips, root motion, bounds, sockets)
evaluated pose checks (floor, death on the floor, loop seams)

approvals.evidence: docs/art-bible.md: sentry-sheet-1.png picked for the Cog Sentry

approvals.notes: review sheet ANIMATION sections (Blender frames and engine stills)
create-rigged-character-assets requires an independent >= 80/100 score; unscored means unaccepted

independentScore.scorer: independent reviewer agent (separate from the authoring agent; did not build the asset)

rubric.note: Up from 19. Front review render model-low-front.png (640x640, figure H 428 px, y115-543, unchanged): head 40 px wide (0.093 of H, concept 0.099) and 55 px tall (0.128, concept 0.135), height/width 1.38 against the concept's 1.37, tapering from 40 px at y130-145 to 22 px at the chin (55% of max, concept 47/89 = 53%). Pauldron span 252-388 = 136 px, 0.318 of H (concept 286/902 = 0.317). Hands end at 0.62 of H (concept 0.62). Pass-1 fix 1 (knee break) is CLOSED: front render columns x294 and x345 run continuously from thigh through the new brass knee cop (y398-418) into the shin (y422-502), with shadowed-brass values about (87,47,13) at y385-395 and no wall colour; engine idle.jpg columns x445/x510 and p4-sentry-idle.jpg x450/x500 show no floor colour (139,99,73) between thigh and shin, attack.jpg knees show the dark joint (23,17,13), and rig-rom-crouch.png, hit.jpg and p4-sentry-attack.jpg show the knee holding under flexion. Thighs now taper (front 35 px at y345 to 28-30 px at y380-385). Side profile model-low-side.png: chest depth 68 px (0.159 of H) matches the concept plate depth once its glow halo is excluded (about 0.16); shin depth swells from 34 px below the knee to 38 px at y435-451 then tapers to 21 px at the ankle, a 1.12 swell against the concept's roughly 1.14, but it sits high and the lower leg is a straight vertical column (x304-339) with none of the concept's rearward calf angle; the front shin tapers monotonically (27 to 19 px). Pass-1 fix 2 is OPEN: pauldrons are still near-spheres in every view, and the cuirass is a rounded barrel with vertical stave strips rather than the concept's angular layered pectoral plates, which remains the main silhouette gap. Concept leg widths could not be measured reliably (brass-to-grey background contrast too low in shadow), so thigh taper is not compared numerically.

Up from 19. Pass-1 fix 4 (head) is CLOSED: the round helmet dome, visor bar and chin block are gone; the head is now a narrow faceless mask, taller than wide, tapering to a pointed chin with a central ridge and a brow line (glow-close.jpg, idle.jpg, model-low-front.png). Still present from pass 1: hex core in a pale bezel with a small second hex below (glow-close core median (247,186,76)), three amber waist pips on ribbed gunmetal (median (245,191,74)), exposed neck rods, back gear medallion (model-low-back.png), faceted multi-colour jewels on upper arm and outer thigh. Jewels, own method (HSV S>0.4, V>0.25, hue outside 5-65 deg): side render 233 px and back render 312 px against concept side 1665 and back 1669; scaled by the squared figure-height ratio (428/902, factor 0.224) that is 63% (side) and 84% (back) of the concept's jewel area, against pass 1's reported ~30% (pass 1 used a different mask, so compare ratios, not raw counts). Remaining misses: the eyes are rectangular slits under a brow bar while the concept's eyes are round glowing orbs; the core centre is not white-hot (glow-close core p95 (252,223,84), identical to pass 1; the p98 (253,244,227) is the pale bezel), an open owner item, noted, not scored.

Up from 13. Thighs now carry front plate panels with vertical seams and raised lips (idle.jpg, p4-sentry-attack.jpg, hit.jpg); forearm bracers are banded shells with ring lips; the knee is a polished brass cop over a dark joint instead of a plain dark disc; the shin top has a lit brass rim (rig-rom-crouch.png, hit.jpg). Brass stays smooth polished metal with clean highlights (no wood grain). Remaining: the chest panelling reads as vertical barrel staves, not overlapping sculpted plates; the pauldrons are bare spheres with no shell layering or lip; shins carry only faint seams; the back is a rounded shell with a flat inset gear panel rather than the concept's layered back plates. Pass-1 fix 3 is PARTIAL (seams and plate lips added, forearm now one banded shell, calf swell weak and placed high).

Up from 11. Warm-metal mask (HSV hue 15-55, S>0.3, V>0.12), concept front body box (640,150)-(1060,950) of the 2752x1536 sheet: median (97,69,49), HLS hue 25, L 0.29, S 0.33, p90-luminance mean (218,181,117). Engine idle.jpg box (350,60)-(620,420): median (93,60,34), hue 26, L 0.25, S 0.46, highlights (208,166,115); glow-close (91,58,32) hue 26 S 0.48; p4-sentry-idle (94,62,37) hue 26 S 0.44. Hue gap closed from 6 to about 1 degree and engine hue moved from 30 to 26; saturation still 0.13 high (was 0.16 high under pass 1's box) and value about 0.04 darker, so the brass still leans orange-ochre over dusty bronze. Eyes median (248,202,84), p95 (253,220,102) against concept eyes p90 (254,244,128): close, slightly less hot. Jewel accent colour now reads in a front-facing engine shot (p4-sentry-idle.jpg, 107 jewel px, blue/purple/red), which pass 1 said none did. The Blender EEVEE renders read more saturated copper than the engine; the engine shots were used for this criterion as the shipped look.

Up from 7. The thigh-knee break that showed floor through the legs at 2-4 m is gone in idle, attack, hit and frozen engine shots; the tapered mask head with lit slits, the hex core and the waist pips give three stacked amber focal points on a figure that separates cleanly from the dark wall; the gunmetal waist pinch reads as a humanoid hourglass. Not recovered: the spherical pauldrons and staved barrel chest still read as a toy robot rather than the concept's armoured knight-automaton (pass-1 fix 2 open).

topFixes: Reshape the round primitives into the concept's angular plate shapes: flatten and layer the pauldrons into two or three overlapping curved shells with a lip instead of spheres, and replace the staved barrel cuirass with faceted left and right pectoral plates and a sternum ridge around the hex core (pass-1 fix 2, untouched; the largest remaining silhouette, surface and readability gap).

Give the lower leg the concept's profile: move the calf swell down to mid-shin, angle the greave rearward in side view instead of a straight vertical column, and add a calf swell in the front view (front shin now tapers monotonically 27 to 19 px).
Make the eyes round glowing orbs set into the mask as in the concept, instead of rectangular slits under a brow bar, and push them hotter toward the concept's p90 (254,244,128).
Pull engine brass saturation from about 0.46 toward 0.33 and lift value from L 0.25 toward 0.29 at the same hue 25-26 to reach the concept's dusty bronze.

Replace the flat inset gear panel on the back with layered back plates around a raised gear, and grow the side jewels the remaining ~1.5x in area (now 63% side, 84% back of the concept's scaled jewel area).
independentScore.method: Independent reviewer (did not build the asset) on 2026-11-16, scoring commit e840968 against the approved assets-source/concepts/sentry-sheet-1.png with the same rubric and maxima as pass 1 (score-sentry-v2.json, 69). Shape from the Blender review renders (model-low-front/side/back/three-quarter, model-high-three-quarter, rig-rom-crouch/reach, cog-sentry.review-sheet.jpg); colour, glow and readability from staging/engine/{idle,glow-close,attack,hit,frozen}.jpg and docs/verification/p4-sentry-{idle,attack}.jpg. The stale docs/verification/p6-glow-cog-sentry.jpg and the author's self-score and build notes were not used. Proportions from per-row background-difference run widths (row background = median of columns 150-200 and 440-490, threshold 45 summed RGB) on the 640x640 renders, normalised to figure height 428 px; side-shin depth from an HSV S>150 mask below the floor line; knee continuity from column RGB profiles. Concept figure height 902 px (y48-950), head and shoulder widths from row run extents. Colours are Pillow/NumPy medians and top-decile means over an HSV warm-metal mask (hue 15-55, S>0.3, V>0.12) inside stated boxes; glow over HSV masks (V>0.8, S>0.45, hue 25-60) inside core, eye and pip boxes; jewel pixels by HSV (S>0.4, V>0.25, hue outside 5-65) scaled by the squared figure-height ratio. Concept leg widths could not be segmented reliably and were not compared numerically. The white-hot core centre is an open owner item and was noted but not scored down. No files were written other than this JSON.
